scope: complete generator-excluded exact-title population under reproduced current YV product search

distinct_parent_recall.note: Low multi-parent recall is expected for structurally ambiguous too-many-parent titles and is not itself a search failure. It counts distinct generator-mapped occupation identities, not duplicate YV rows.

non_target_prefix_before_first_mapped_pa.interpretation: High weighted share is driven by a few very frequent broad terms such as Säljare; it does not imply loss of findability when a mapped parent remains immediately visible.

high_volume_examples.interpretation: variant overload / structural ambiguity; not a demonstrated missing-findability defect

counterfactual.rule: for an exact generator-excluded title only, place its already generator-mapped occupation parents first
counterfactual.interpretation: Diagnostic ceiling only. It cannot resolve which parent a user intended and is therefore not evidence for a global parent-first production rule.

decision.reason: Current product already exposes a mapped route for 98.863% of observed excluded-title volume within top 5, while the remaining too-many-parent cases are structurally ambiguous. Forcing all mapped parents first would manufacture apparent recall without resolving intent.
decision.next_track1_work: review the high-volume no-mapped-parent residuals individually; then close YV->KV context handoff/coherence and freeze the compact failure-mode map
